verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Cloud Storage (Cloud Storage for Firebase, Cloud Storage triggers) and Security Rules that explicitly cover Cloud Storage with Auth-based, user-level permissions; a community comment also confirms storage rules are in real use. However, the pack never describes the upload/download file workflow and says nothing about CDN-backed delivery of user files. missing for 10: explicit documentation of file upload/serve APIs, any evidence of CDN-backed delivery for stored files, hands-on corroboration of the storage workflow.
